question: Which thunderbolt-bearing goddess is invoked to always protect at the crossroads?
premises: Protection is sought at the crossroads.
The protector is the bearer of the thunderbolt.
inference: The thunderbolt-bearing goddess always protects the speaker at the crossroads.
uncertainties: vajra-dhāriṇī may refer to Indrāṇī or another vajra-bearing goddess.
plain_english: May the bearer of the thunderbolt always protect me at the crossroads.
